reviews.text: Color matching was so hard. I’m a medium neutral (in the US) when I’m pale, and was hoping #23 neutral would work for me. But it’s so light! I have to mix this with my other concealers to make it work. Wish they had more concealers in the 23-27 range.
reviews.zh: 對色真係好難。我係美國標準嘅 medium neutral（皮膚較白嗰陣），本來希望 #23 neutral 會啱我。但係太淺喇！我要溝埋其他遮瑕先用得到。希望佢哋可以出多啲 23-27 之間嘅遮瑕色號。

reviews.text: Obsessed with Hince Second Skin Concealer in #21 Light! It’s creamy, blends like a dream, and covers my dark circles and blemishes without feeling heavy. Perfect shade for my fair skin, and it lasts all day with zero creasing. The stick applicator is super precise, too. Already my holy grail—10/10, will repurchase!
reviews.zh: 勁鍾意 Hince Second Skin Concealer #21 Light！質地好 creamy，推開好似發夢咁順，可以遮住我嘅黑眼圈同暗瘡印，但又唔會覺得厚重。色號啱晒我呢種白皮膚，仲要用足全日都零摺紋。支裝嘅設計上妝好精準。已經成為我嘅神級產品——10/10，一定會回購！

reviews.text: I just love this concealer! it is my favorite. I tried it the first time when I went to Korea the 1st time and I keep on using them all the time. It gives a nice coverage, it doesn't look tacky or gets creases but keeps the skin glowy. Love it!
reviews.zh: 我超鍾意呢支遮瑕！佢係我最愛。我第一次去韓國嘅時候第一次試，之後就一路用緊。遮瑕度好靚，望落唔會黐立立又唔會有摺紋，但係keep到皮膚有水光感。鍾意！

reviews.text: I love that way it sits on my face but the only problem is that I ordered the wrong shade and it was too light for me🥲 I would’ve definitely go a shade darker next time. Other than that I think it’s a really good concealer.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意佢上咗塊面嘅感覺，但唯一嘅問題係我買錯咗色號，對我嚟講太淺咗🥲下次一定會揀深一個色號。除咗呢一點，我覺得呢支係一支好正嘅遮瑕。

reviews.text: It literally came in so fast! And it was perfect! Clean, well packaged, EVERYTHING! I've also really been wanting to try concealer and have been looking for one for a while now and this one DEFO lives up to my high standards and expectation! I definitely do recommend!!
reviews.zh: 簡直送到超快！而且好完美！乾淨，包裝好，樣樣都好！我一直好想試遮瑕膏，亦都搵咗一輪，呢個真係完全符合我嘅高標準同期望！絕對推薦！！

reviews.text: The shade match is excellent, it feels light and airy on the skin, but unfortunately for me, it creases like crazy. Wearing it alone, or over foundation doesn’t seem to make a difference, nor does applying it over a primer. I’m trying to only use it in areas where creasing isn’t an issue, but I’m a little sad because it goes on so nicely and smooth, but it just doesn’t last for me. Maybe it just doesn’t get along with my combination skin?
reviews.zh: 色號好啱，上臉感覺輕盈透氣，但對我嚟講好不幸，係嚴重卡紋。單獨用或者喺粉底上面用都冇分別，搽咗打底都一樣。我而家只係試下用喺冇咁易卡紋嘅位置，但有少少失望，因為佢上妝好順滑，但就係撐唔到好耐。可能真係同我嘅混合性肌膚夾唔到？

reviews.text:
It is a decent product that looks good when applied but it did accentuate dry patches on my skin which became very apparent later in the day. Make sure your skin is well hydrated and exfoliated before use. I put on this product in the morning and by the evening it was a pretty patchy and textured finish on my face.

The product has a slight fragrance that I don't mind but if you are sensitive to scent, I would not recommend it. The darkest shade was still a tad too light for my summer skin tone -- I am asian light-medium skin tone.
reviews.zh:
算係唔錯嘅產品，上妝效果睇落幾好，但係會突出我皮膚上嘅乾紋，到咗夜晚更加明顯。用之前記得做好保濕同去角質。我朝早搽，到夜晚個妝就變得好斑駁、好有顆粒感。

產品有少少香味，我自己唔介意，但如果你對香味敏感，就唔建議用。最深色嗰個對我嘅夏天膚色嚟講都仲係偏淺少少——我係亞洲人偏淺至中等嘅膚色。

reviews.text: Very nice medium-full coverage concealer. I bought 24 Buff yet it’s more like a light 23. Too light for my light-medium skin (took one star off). It’s like a thinner version of the NARS creamy radiant concealer. Would recommend if you have lighter/fairer skin
reviews.zh: 好正嘅中至高度遮瑕。我買咗 24 Buff，但實際比較似淺色嘅 23。對我嘅淺至中等膚色嚟講太淺（所以扣咗一星）。感覺似 NARS creamy radiant 遮瑕嘅薄身版。膚色較淺／白皙嘅人會推薦。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
